description: This file defines the MigrationPluginManager class, which manages migration plugins in Drupal, including plugin discovery, creation, dependency management, and definition handling.

classes.name: MigrationPluginManager
classes.description: Manages migration plugins, including discovery, creation, dependency resolution, and definition handling within Drupal's migration system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MigrationPluginManager with module handler, cache backend, and language manager.

methods.name: getDiscovery
methods.description: Overrides default to discover migration configurations in module 'migrations' directories, applying decorators to filter migrations.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a single migration plugin instance by ID with optional configuration.

methods.name: createInstances
methods.description: Creates multiple migration plugin instances, expanding derivative migrations and sorting by dependencies.

methods.name: createInstancesByTag
methods.description: Creates migration instances filtered by a specific tag.

methods.name: expandPluginIds
methods.description: Expands migration IDs to include derivative plugins based on definitions.

methods.name: buildDependencyMigration
methods.description: Builds and sorts migration dependencies graph, handling optional and required dependencies.

methods.name: addDependency
methods.description: Adds dependency edges to a graph for migration dependencies.

methods.name: createStubMigration
methods.description: Creates a stub migration object from a definition.

methods.name: findDefinitions
methods.description: Discovers and processes plugin definitions, filtering by provider existence.
